name: deepseek-supervisor
description: "You should know" for Claude Code on a third-party model such as DeepSeek: every few steps a side pass reviews the work and tells the model, and the person, what it notices

every.title: Steps between passes
every.description: Main-loop steps between two review passes (the built-in "You should know" uses 6).

turn_end.title: Review at turn end
turn_end.description: Also review each turn's final answer, where "done" and "verified" are said.

max_wakes.title: Follow-up turns per prompt
max_wakes.description: How many times per prompt of yours a high-severity finding at the end of a turn may start a turn that settles it (0: never; the note waits for your next prompt).

reviewer_model.title: Reviewer model
reviewer_model.description: Empty: the review forks the session on its own model, served from its prompt cache. A model id (such as deepseek-reasoner): that model reviews the transcript on its own, outside the author's framing.
